November 2023 special legislative session, appropriated
100% of the State Fiscal Recovery Fund (SFRF) allocation.
Due to its extraordinary revenue loss during the pandemic,
North Dakota’s entire SFRF allocation is dedicated to
project expenditure category group 6 – Revenue
Replacement. Consequently, all expenditures will fall under
project expenditure category 6.1 – Provision of Government
Services. Government services, as defined by the North
Dakota legislature, includes economic development and
